name: DNUP

rounds.endCondition: First player to reach 4 or more letter tokens wins immediately

categories.label: Letter tokens won per round
categories.labelVi: Số token chữ thắng mỗi ván
categories.hint: First player out of cards: 2 tokens; second player out: 1 token (round ends then).

tiebreakers.description: Not needed: game ends immediately when a player reaches 4+ tokens, after that round's awards.

winCondition: First player to get 4 or more letter tokens wins immediately. In the 2-player game, first to win 2 rounds wins.

endCondition.description: Round ends when the second player empties their hand.

notes: family: climbing-shedding. 2-player variant: round winner takes the round (no tokens), first to 2 round wins; use letterTokens = 1 per round won and win at 2. BGG description (secondary) differs slightly: most points once someone has 4+; official rulebook says immediate win at 4+.
